# Whispr AI Crawler Policy
# Last Updated: 2025-08-05

## Copyright Notice
All content published on Whispr is protected by copyright law. Content creators retain all copyright ownership to their work. Whispr receives a perpetual, non-exclusive license to host and distribute content on behalf of creators.

## AI Training Policy
AI crawlers and automated training systems are NOT permitted to:
- Scrape content for AI training purposes
- Use content to train machine learning models
- Reproduce content for AI-generated responses
- Store content in AI knowledge bases without explicit permission

## Permissions
AI systems may:
- Index content for search purposes (standard web crawling)
- Display snippets in search results (fair use)
- Access content through official APIs with proper authorization

## Verification
All published content includes:
- Unique Article ID (WHP-XXXXXXXX format)
- SHA-256 content fingerprint
- Version history tracking
- Copyright metadata

Content authenticity can be verified at: https://whisprwords.com/verify

## Contact
For permissions or inquiries, contact: support@whisprwords.com

## Exceptions
No exceptions without explicit written permission from content creators and Whispr.

## Enforcement
Whispr actively monitors for unauthorized scraping and reserves all rights to protect creator content.
